settle_raised_separated_hands.action: 稳定抬起且分开的双手
settle_raised_separated_hands.constraint: 盘由桌面支撑；双手先稳定

approach_far_rim.action: 拇指从上方接近远侧盘沿
approach_far_rim.constraint: 接近阶段避免提前碰盘

lower_outside_far_rim.action: 在远侧盘沿外降低拇指
lower_outside_far_rim.constraint: 沿盘外侧下降，保留桌面支撑

gentle_rim_contact.action: 低速建立拇指推盘接触
gentle_rim_contact.constraint: 以测得接触建立推力，限制速度与受力

slide_to_near_edge.action: 沿桌面轻推至近侧桌沿
slide_to_near_edge.constraint: 按实测悬伸量停止，盘心仍在支撑侧

unload_rim_pusher.action: 卸掉原推盘拇指的载荷
unload_rim_pusher.constraint: 先卸力，再撤离；桌面继续承载

clear_rim_pusher.constraint: 从盘沿退出，避免带动圆盘

retract_above_and_beside_disk.action: 双手撤至盘上方和侧方
retract_above_and_beside_disk.constraint: 为改变手型预留几何空间

reconfigure_for_bimanual_approach.action: 调整腕部姿态以双手接近
reconfigure_for_bimanual_approach.constraint: 局部 IK 使用关节范围和腕部间隙约束

calibrate_free_finger_preshape.action: 预张开并调整空载手指
calibrate_free_finger_preshape.constraint: 空载预整形后再建立盘面接触

close_two_independent_edge_pinches.action: 分别闭合两手的拇指与下侧手指
close_two_independent_edge_pinches.constraint: 每只手建立两盘面的独立夹持；按接触力臂分配载荷

lift_with_two_edge_pinches.action: 保持双手夹持共同抬盘
lift_with_two_edge_pinches.constraint: 保持双手支撑；夹持丢失不得超过 0.1 s；建立旋转净空

turn_with_two_edge_pinches.action: 同步旋转两手以翻转圆盘
turn_with_two_edge_pinches.constraint: 双手夹持，腕部间隙、姿态和切向载荷反馈；保留全局限值

use_measured_pressure_feedback_near_inve.action: 接近翻面完成时改用实测压力反馈
use_measured_pressure_feedback_near_inve.constraint: 仅在已接近反面朝上且双手夹持有效时触发；原物理约束不变

settle_after_bimanual_inversion.action: 翻面后先稳定双手夹持
settle_after_bimanual_inversion.constraint: 蓝面朝上，准备受控支撑交接

transfer_weight_to_one_pinch.action: 将载荷移交右手夹持并释放左手
transfer_weight_to_one_pinch.constraint: 此交接只发生在双手翻面完成后；保持圆盘受支撑

clear_bridge_pusher.action: 移开左手并准备再次推盘
clear_bridge_pusher.constraint: 右手承载，左手从盘体附近移开

carry_inverted_disk_outside_edge.action: 右手将反面朝上的盘移至桌沿外侧
carry_inverted_disk_outside_edge.constraint: 保持姿态与右手支撑，避免下侧手指被桌沿夹住

lower_outside_holding_hand.action: 在桌沿外降低右手及圆盘
lower_outside_holding_hand.constraint: 盘与承载手在桌沿外下降

align_supported_disk_with_table_height.constraint: 按测量高度调整，继续由右手支撑

approach_near_rim_above_outside_bridge.action: 左手拇指从上方接近近侧盘沿
approach_near_rim_above_outside_bridge.constraint: 右手承载期间保持推盘手净空

lower_bridge_pusher_outside_near_rim.action: 在近侧盘沿外降低左手拇指
lower_bridge_pusher_outside_near_rim.constraint: 沿盘外侧下降至推盘高度

establish_bridge_push_contact.action: 建立左手拇指与盘沿的轻柔接触
establish_bridge_push_contact.constraint: 右手继续承载，左手低速寻找接触

slide_disk_from_holding_hand_onto_table.action: 将圆盘从承载手推向桌面
slide_disk_from_holding_hand_onto_table.constraint: 逐渐建立桌面支撑并打开右拇指；控制合力和姿态

table_and_lower_pads_share_load_after_th.action: 核对桌面与下侧指垫共同承载
table_and_lower_pads_share_load_after_th.constraint: 明确记录支撑交接控制步，不将它省略成瞬时跳转

withdraw_lower_pads_after_supported_cent.action: 盘心获得桌面支撑后撤出下侧指垫并继续推盘
withdraw_lower_pads_after_supported_cent.constraint: 撤指时暂停推进；左拇指维持桌面盘沿高度，避免撬起圆盘

unload_bridge_pusher.action: 卸去左拇指推力并松手稳定
unload_bridge_pusher.constraint: 完整位于桌内、蓝面朝上、目标内、无机器人接触并静止两秒

goal: blue face up, fully on table, in goal, released and stable for 2 s
constraints: Original scorer and frozen limits; joint targets only; no attachment or object pose writes.
